messages:
yasmin: Quick sync — PR #4123 updates SDK snippets for streaming + pagination across Python/TS/Go to use cursor-based async iterators and add retry examples. Need docs review + a quick check from eng-runtime that the examples don't assume KV prefix caching behavior. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4123

mike: on it. Ping me if we need a minimal runtime note.

lena: I skimmed — python example replaces generator with async iterator which is good. But pagination example still uses `page_size` param; we should show cursor usage too.

sam: assigning to @lena @mike for content review. I'll check the TypeScript snippet for correctness.

mike: small TS fix — streaming code should await the async iterator call:
```
for await (const chunk of client.responses.stream(...)) {
  processChunk(chunk)
}
```
Also added retry backoff note.

lena: Python snippet draft:
```
async for page in client.list_items.cursor_iter(page_size=50):
    for item in page.items:
        handle(item)
```
Note: use `client.list_items.cursor_iter()` not deprecated `list_items_pages()`

toni: runtime note — cursor semantics are stable but the prefix/KV cache may collapse consecutive cursors if callers rely on streaming + pagination interleaving. Suggest adding a short "compat" caveat under the example.

yasmin: Good catch @toni. Can you propose one sentence we can add? I can paste it into the PR.

toni: Proposed line: "If you interleave streaming responses with cursor-based pagination, ensure your client preserves per-request sequence; some server-side KV prefix caching can return cached prefixes — add unique request_id or use the 'no_cache' flag when testing." :warning: 

docs-bot: lint: code-block-style OK. link-checker: 1 broken link (internal): /guides/old-pagination -> replaced in PR

sam: I pushed a tiny change to TS snippet to include retry-with-jitter example.

mike: LGTM on TS. Lena, can you sign off on Python? If so I'll merge and then we can ping eng-runtime for a quick thumbs-up.

lena: Signed off. Left one nit about variable names. I added it inline.

yasmin: thanks everyone — merging after CI passes. I'll follow up with eng-runtime for the cache wording confirmation.

mike: I'll take the runtime ping after merge.

yasmin: done — PR merged (gh:4123). Closing thread.
